I'm weighing whether to buy Boardwalk for $400. I have $1308 cash and would retain $908 after purchase. The other dark blue property is owned by p4, who has only $272 cash. Purchasing it would block them from completing the monopoly without trading with me.

Auctioning Boardwalk is too risky. p4 could win it for $272 and complete the dark blue monopoly. The other players might also bid. Buying directly is the safer choice.

I would become the gatekeeper for the dark blue set. p4 would need to trade with me to complete it. The $400 purchase price is fair value.

Auctioning Boardwalk would let p1 or p2 win it instead. I would lose the leverage over p4's Park Place. I want to own it myself so I can trade it later for a color set or other valuable properties.
